detail.longDescription: Hi All - I've been missing Winamp for a long time and could not find a simple, fast audio player for macOS that I liked. So, I built Vibe. It's a fast, minimal music file player for Mac. It's written in Objective-C and optimized heavily for speed, resource use, and quality. ~12Mb app. No accounts, telemetry, or bloat. It's free and open source: https://github.com/cmicali/vibe Also available on the Mac App Store if you prefer: https://apps.apple.com/us/app/vibe-music-player/id1582482361... I started this before "Vibe" had it's meaning changed, so it was completely hand-written for the first 4-5 years. Now I am using agents to speed up progress and implement things I otherwise wouldn't have had the time to do. I would love any feedback, ideas, feature requests etc.
